---
description: Create a commit message from my changes
agent: agent
---

Create a Git commit message based on the current changes.

Use this format:

<type>(<scope>): <summary>

Body:

- Explain what changed
- Explain why it changed if obvious from the diff

Rules:

- Use Conventional Commits
- Prefer: feat, fix, refactor, chore, docs, test
- Keep the first line short
- Do not include markdown fences
